data.name: EscapeOS
data.subtitle: App-data browser and backup for sideloaded apps
data.localizedDescription: EscapeOS is an on-device file browser and app-data backup/restore tool for sideloaded iOS, using a path-scoped container sandbox escape. No jailbreak, no Keychain. Browse an app's Documents, Library and tmp folders, edit or compress files, back up to an archive with a SHA-256 manifest, or reclaim cache space.
data.versionDescription:
EscapeOS 0.1.5 | EscapeOS-0.1.5

## EscapeOS 0.1.5

v0.1.0, v0.1.1, v0.1.3, and v0.1.4 are unchanged.

### Added
- **Reclaim** tab ranks apps by Safe cache and temp size (`tmp`, `Library/Caches`, logs, splash snapshots, GPU cache)
- Per-app Reclaim Space from App Detail; Session buckets (cookies, WebKit, HTTP storage) are opt-in
- Batch reclaim is Safe-only. Documents, Preferences, and Application Support are never reclaimed
- Opening an app after a tab scan reuses those Safe sizes instead of measuring again
- Locked cache files (permission denied, e.g. some `Library/Caches/FileData` folders) are skipped instead of failing the whole reclaim
- **Reset App Data** on App Detail empties Documents, Library, and tmp. Keychain and App Groups are not touched. Resetting EscapeOS itself warns that the pairing file will be deleted

Hardware-checked on iPhone 17, iOS 26.5.1. After install, reconnect LocalDevVPN if the list is empty; iPASide places `pairingFile.plist` again after sideload. Close the target app before reclaiming or resetting.

`EscapeOS-0.1.5.ipa` SHA-256:

```
231d5e56ceb13df6db688d2ba9838bb18d12a364583655b32042ab3b143cdb02
```
